# Life of Adam and Eve Chapter 5 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Latin MS (Vita Adae et Evae) | **Section:** Satan's Story — Why He Refused to Worship Adam

---

**1** Adam said to the devil: 'Why are you fighting against us? What have we done to you? Why do you pursue us with trickery and jealousy?'

**2** The devil heaved a great sigh and answered: 'Adam, all my hatred and jealousy and suffering come down to you. It is because of you that I was thrown out of heaven and banished from the angels.'

**3** 'What did I do to you?' Adam asked. 'How am I responsible? You've suffered nothing from me.'

**4** The devil replied: 'When you were created, I was thrown out. When God breathed the breath of life into you and made you in his image, Michael brought you forward and had you worship before God — in front of all the angels. Then God said: "Worship Adam." And I did worship you.'

---
*PNEUMA: modern English; verse-only numbering.*
